schemas.name: ClinGen Gene-Disease Validity SOP
schemas.description: ClinGen Standard Operating Procedures for Gene-Disease Clinical Validity Curation (September 2024)

pmid_format.rule: all PMIDs must be numeric strings

lod_score_consistency.message: LOD score must be non-negative for segregation evidence

genetic_evidence_required.message: At least one genetic evidence item is required

genetic_evidence.label: Genetic Evidence

case_level.label: Case-Level Data

sources.label: Sources
sources.description: Where the row comes from: PMID, DOI, ClinVar (VCV/RCV/SCV), ClinGen allele (CA) or validity (CGGV), URL or database record, with the tool and retrieval date (VA-Spec reportedIn)

other_variant_type.label: Other Variant Type
other_variant_type.description: Null + Other starts at 1.5 (SOP v11 GCI-rounded example); two other or homozygous other starts at 0.2 (0–3 per proband). Starting suggestions assume qualifying biallelic evidence. Reassess the score for the case; loaded or manually edited scores stay unchanged when the variant type changes.

predicted_or_proven_null.label: Predicted or Proven Null
predicted_or_proven_null.description: Two null variants or homozygous null: starting suggestion 3 points (0–3 per proband). Starting suggestions assume qualifying biallelic evidence. Reassess the score for the case; loaded or manually edited scores stay unchanged when the variant type changes.

bands.description: Total score 12-18 points (Strong) with replication over time supports a DEFINITIVE gene-disease relationship.
Total score 12-18 points supports STRONG gene-disease relationship.
Total score 7-11 points supports MODERATE gene-disease relationship.
Total score 1-6 points supports LIMITED gene-disease relationship.
No evidence supporting a gene-disease relationship.
Conflicting or contradictory evidence present, resulting in DISPUTED classification.

overrides.description: Contradictory evidence with impact Disputed present, resulting in DISPUTED classification.
